svg.text: Three layers of obligation, and who enforces each

g.text: THE LAW
copyright, data protection (GDPR, PIPL), safety, fraud
enforced by courts; the floor, not the standard
"legal" and "right" are different words
THE PROFESSION'S CODE
BCS Code of Conduct, IEEE Code of Ethics, ACM Code
enforced by the body: complaints, expulsion, the register
written down so you need not decide alone under pressure
YOUR OWN JUDGEMENT
the case the code did not foresee; the order you refuse
enforced by no one but you, which is the point
the layer that decided Horizon, Dieselgate and MCAS

svg.text: each layer catches what the one above missed; none replaces the one below it
The BCS Code of Conduct: four duties

g.text: 1 Public interest
health, privacy, security and wellbeing of others and the environment;
the rights of third parties; no discrimination
2 Professional competence and integrity
only work you are competent to do; keep skills current; no bribery;
accept and offer honest criticism; do not misrepresent
3 Duty to the relevant authority
carry out the work with care; avoid conflicts of interest; no misuse
of information; accept responsibility for your work
4 Duty to the profession
uphold the profession's reputation; support and encourage colleagues;
act with integrity towards members of other professions

svg.text: the exam's 'towards colleagues' answers come from 2 and 4; 'towards the public' from 1
